result.description:
Position: ICT Project Manager
Type: Full-time
Employer: Mienterprise Pty Ltd
Location: Melbourne VIC
Salary: $100,000 p/a
About the Business:
Mienterprise Pty Ltd, trading as SENPOS, is a leading Australian point-of-sale technology company with over 30 years of experience delivering powerful, integrated POS solutions to hospitality venues, golf clubs, and entertainment establishments across Australia and New Zealand. With offices in Newcastle, Wollongong, Gold Coast, and Rockhampton, SENPOS combines home-grown software and hardware development with exceptional local support to streamline operations, enhance customer engagement, and drive business profitability. We pride ourselves on building long-lasting partnerships, providing responsive 24/7 support, and fostering a collaborative, innovative workplace culture where team members contribute to cutting-edge projects that make a real difference for our clients.
About the Position:
The ICT Project Manager leads the end-to-end delivery of point of sale implementation projects for our clients across hospitality, retail, and entertainment. Reporting to Strategy and Ops, the role plans, coordinates, and delivers multiple concurrent projects, manages system integrations, and ensures a smooth transition from initiation through to go-live and handover to Support, all within agreed timeframes and budgets.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously, from initiation through to post go-live review.
Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, and resource requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project plans and communication logs.
Coordinate across internal teams, including implementations, development, support, product, and training, to ensure deliverables meet quality standards.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
Manage and configure all system integrations, including payment gateways, EFTPOS and payment terminals, POS hardware, access control, online ordering and websites, and third-party vendor connections, ensuring successful end-to-end connectivity and testing.
Conduct regular project status meetings with clients and internal teams.
Manage client expectations and ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables.
Oversee testing, data validation, and handover to the Support team following go-live.
Support the continuous improvement of implementation methodologies and documentation.
Contribute to internal and client-facing process improvement initiatives.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Tertiary qualification (Bachelor level) in ICT or a related field.
Minimum 5–10 years of experience in ICT project management.
Highly desirable: demonstrated experience within point of sale (POS), IT, or club management systems.
Strong technical skills in project management methodologies, system integrations, POS hardware/software, and ICT security practices.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage client expectations.
Proven ability to deliver multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

ABOUT US

About Kilcoy Global Foods

Kilcoy Global Foods is a multi-award-winning global foods solutions business, renowned for exceptional quality and innovation. Specialising in premium Australian beef, lamb and high-quality protein products, Kilcoy Global Foods products are enjoyed in more than 50 countries.

 

To learn more about who we are and what we do, visit our website: www.kilcoyglobalfoods.com

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Job Title: Night Shift Maintenance Supervisor

Company Name: Kilcoy Pastoral Company Limited

Location: 4830 D'Aguilar Highway, Winya Queensland 4515. 

Employment Type: Permanent.

Renumeration: $68 - $68.50

To supervise and lead the Night Shift Maintenance team activities for the relevant shift. Deliver reactive and preventative maintenance support to ensure the plant has minimal lost time due to mechanical fault/failure and achieve optimal use of current and future mechanical assets.

Supervising and leading the Maintenance team activities
Delivering preventative and reactive maintenance support
Ensuring the plant has minimal lost time due to mechanical fault/failure
Achieve optimal use of current and future mechanical assets
Administering shift resources appropriately
Working closely with all production managers, other supervisors to deliver quality outcomes
Commitment to the business and the ability to positively react to situations as they may arise, whilst finding the best solution
Maximising employee health and safety
 

 ABOUT YOU

Direct experience in a manufacturing operation, especially meat processing
A proven successful management record in leading a repair and preventative maintenance team.
Computer literacy skills, including Word, Citec.
Experience in MEX or a similar CMMS
Demonstrated capability in effective Contractor management and coordination.
Ability to work through change, drive continuous improvement initiatives and have exceptional communication, negotiation, technical and leadership skills.
Knowledge of and experience in management of refrigeration, waste water, steam generation and environmental technology.
A proven record of driving safety compliance and culture, including but not limited to,  Forklift operations, EWP, working at heights and Confined space training.
Preventative maintenance system experience.
 

QUALIFICATIONS

Trade Qualifications with at least five (5) years relevant experience
Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership and technical skills. 
Experience at a supervisory level, with at least 3 years’ experience managing a team of tradespersons.
Ability to react and prioritize breakdown situations in a production environment which requires downtime to be minimised.
Current driver's license
 

BENEFITS

Access to discounted premium meat
An organisation where cultural diversity is celebrated
Access to discounted health insurance
 

This is a long-term career opportunity, working for an enterprise business with Corporate Offices on the Sunshine Coast in Queensland.  We have recorded business growth of 20% year on year with sales in excess of $3 billion.  We are committed to building a work environment that fosters an agile plus flexible workplace and where employee wellbeing is paramount.

 

HOW TO APPLY

If you are looking to join a company that promotes innovation, is a leader in industry and champions success, then apply now.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and make every effort to select the best qualified individual for the job based on job related qualifications and experiences. Some of the information we collect via your application form and resume is “personal” information as defined by the Privacy Act. All information provided via your application form and resume is treated as confidential.

Service Coordinator - Scheduling & Operations Focus
Part-time | Canberra-based | Customer & technician coordination

About us
We are a proudly local, family-owned electrical & technology services company in Canberra. We deliver end-to-end solutions across electrical, solar, security, air conditioning, and data.

Our reputation is built on reliability, communication, and getting jobs done properly the first time. We work across residential and commercial clients and maintain long-term relationships through consistent delivery.

We run a structured, systems-driven operation using Simpro for job management and simple SOPs to keep everything moving. As we grow, we need someone who can take ownership of the day-to-day coordination of jobs and keep the business flowing efficiently.

The role
This is a hands-on coordination role focused on scheduling, responsiveness, and keeping technicians productive.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring work is booked, planned, and executed efficiently while maintaining a high level of communication with customers.

Book jobs and quote visits as soon as enquiries come in
Plan upcoming work to minimise downtime and maximise productivity

Confident communicator with a focus on fast, clear responses

Proactive and able to work without constant direction
Based in Canberra and available to work from the office

Flexible start and finish times within the middle of the day

result.description:
Greenwood Leather is a proudly Australian, family-run maker of fine leather bags and accessories. Since 2016 we have followed a simple passion to craft leather pieces that people genuinely love. Every wallet, handbag and travel bag is handmade and one of a kind, blending old-world craftsmanship with fresh, considered design. Our products are made from the heart, and each carries its own name. Together they form “families” of designs meant to be companions for life pieces that soften, age and gain character with everyday use, gathering the stories of the journeys and people they travel with. Choosing a Greenwood piece means joining our family: customers who value quality over passing trends and who have a soft spot for individual, unconventional style. Based in Cranbourne West, Victoria, we are a growing brand with big ambitions for how our story reaches the people who will love it. That is where you come in.

Key Responsibilities
•	Plan and carry out market research and brief external specialists where needed to uncover fresh opportunities for both our established bag families and any new pieces or accessories we are considering.
•	Study buyer demand and the wider leather-goods and fashion market, gathering and interpreting sales figures, customer data and other statistics to guide where the brand heads next.
•	Guide decisions across the full marketing mix our product range, pricing, promotions and advertising, sales activity, and the retail and online channels through which our products reach customers.
•	Help drive the growth of the business by shaping, documenting and delivering clear marketing objectives, plans and programs, and tracking how well they perform against our goals.
•	Translate customer and market insight into positioning and messaging that stays true to Greenwood’s handcrafted, story-led identity.
•	Develop and manage campaigns across our website, email, social media and other digital channels to build brand awareness and lift online and in-store sales.
•	Monitor competitors, seasonal trends and emerging channels, and recommend practical ways for Greenwood to respond and stand out.
•	Work closely with the design and production side of the business so that marketing activity reflects the true craftsmanship and unique character of each product.
•	Measure the results of marketing spend and report on performance, using what we learn to sharpen future activity and improve return on investment.
•	Support the customer experience from launches and content to promotions and events so that every touchpoint reinforces the feeling of joining the Greenwood family.

What You’ll Bring
•	A Bachelor degree or higher qualification (AQF level 7 or above) in marketing, business, communications or a related field.
•	At least one year of relevant experience in a marketing role.

Personal Attributes
•	Creative and curious you enjoy finding new angles and telling a story well.
•	Organised and self-motivated, able to juggle several projects and meet deadlines.
•	A natural collaborator who works warmly with a small, tight team.
•	Detail-oriented, with pride in doing things properly.
•	Adaptable and hands-on, happy to roll up your sleeves in a growing business.
•	Aligned with our values authenticity, craftsmanship and individuality over chasing every trend.

Hours, Pay & How to Apply:

Employment type: Full-time, approximately 38 hours per week.

Salary:  $95,000 – $105,000 per annum, plus superannuation.

Location: Cranbourne West, VIC.

If you love the idea of helping a heartfelt Australian brand grow, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a short cover letter telling us why Greenwood Leather is the right fit for you.

Position Overview: 

We are currently seeking motivated and reliable individuals who can work as a Harvest Picker, Production Line Worker and Farm Hand and join our team in Mataranka, NT. These roles are essential to the continued success of our farm operations and provide a great opportunity to work in a dynamic, outdoor environment. 

You may be required to work in any of these roles which is dependent on operational needs and availability of the day. 


Job Descriptions: 

 As a FARM HAND, will assist in the efficient operation and management of the farm. Crops being produced on our farms include mangoes, seedless watermelon, rockmelons, broccoli, and pumpkin.

About the role:
• Operate small tractors to transport fruit.
• Participate in the inspection, grading, sorting, storage, and post-harvest treatment of crops.
• Perform general farm labouring tasks.
• Perform daily pre-start checks.
• Record basic information about crops.
• Dig and plant seeds, or transplant seedlings by hand.
• Harvest fruits and vegetables by hand.
• Load agricultural products into trucks, and drive to storage facilities.

As a PRODUCTION LINE WORKER, you will assist in all-round stock controlling, picking, packing and quality assurance of produce. 

About the role: 
• Receiving incoming goods, checking for damage and for discrepancies between goods and packing orders.
• Unloading vehicles, opening packages, and removing contents.
• Labelling goods with details of storage location.
• Packing and weighing goods and sealing boxes.
• Assisting with regular stocktakes.

As a HARVEST PICKER, your role will include, but are not limited to:

• Picking fruit and vegetables according to size and ripeness by hand
• Discarding rotting and over-ripened produce following our quality standards
• Operating small tractors, when required
• Loading picked fresh produce into containers
• Digging and planting/transplanting seedlings by hand

To be successful in these roles you will possess the following:

• Evidence of work rights.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a can-do attitude
• Team player who can work effectively with people from different backgrounds.
• Awareness and ability to adhere to WHS requirements.
• Flexibility in hours worked to achieve operational targets, including weekends and public holidays.


In return we offer you

• A passionate and energetic team culture.
• Become a part of a progressive, vibrant business.

Number of positions available: 182 total. 

Commencement date: from: March 2027 to November 2027 for 9 months. 
Renumeration: Starting at $32.18/hr (Horticulture Award 2020, Level 1). You will then progress to $33.05 (Horticulture Award 2020, Level 2) after 3 months of continuous employment. 

Who we are?
Rombola Family Farms are located 20kms North of Griffith, NSW and in Mataranka, NT. Our company is a progressive, vibrant, privately owned agricultural business. We are involved in a range of agricultural enterprises including melons, pumpkins, broccoli, citrus, wine grapes and almonds, with operations spanning growing, packing, and marketing of produce.

More information
For more information or a confidential discussion please contact Human Resources at hr@rombolafamilyfarms.com.au. To learn more about working with us, we encourage you to visit our website http://www.rombolafamilyfarms.com/

Above-award pay and conditions.

24/7 access to cutting-edge educational resources and webinars.

If you are enthusiastic about making a difference in the lives of children and being part of a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply.

Resource Corner is global technology enterprise, focused on delivering excellence in complex digital environment, with relentless dedication in IT consulting and services. Resource Corner IT has been working with Banking and Telecom and Federal Department to help them achieve business agility, competitive edge, and growth.

Position Summary:
We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Software Tester to join our team in Australia.
Job location:
Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153, you will be required to work on clients' office (on multiple locations possible), depending on the engagement, whilst remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner

Type of position:
Permanent Ongoing

Minimum Qualification:
Any bachelor’s degree in major computing or equivalent

Experience Range: 5 to 15 years.

Job Description – Software Tester

Responsibilities:

• Researching, consulting, analyzing and evaluating system program needs.
• Identifying technology limitations and deficiencies in existing systems and associated processes, procedures and methods.
• Testing, debugging, diagnosing and correcting errors and faults in an applications programming language within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure programs and applications perform to specification.
• Writing and maintaining program code to meet system requirements, system designs and technical specifications in accordance with quality accredited standards.
• Writing, updating and maintaining technical program, end user documentation and operational procedures.
• Providing advice, guidance and expertise in developing proposals and strategies for software design activities such as financial evaluation and costing for recommending software purchases and upgrades.

Skills Required:

• Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent experience in IT highly regarded.
• Business orientation with strong IT background.
• 5+ years’ experience in software testing in banking, cards, payments, insurance or financial services environment is desirable.

• Testing APIs using REST, SOAP UI, Postman etc.
• Experience on ETL, Data warehouse, Big Data testing is advantageous.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills at all levels.


Salary Range: $100k to $150k plus super

About Loginet Technologies

Loginet Technologies is an Australian technology consulting and digital transformation company committed to helping businesses leverage innovative technologies to improve efficiency, productivity, and sustainable growth. We deliver end-to-end ICT solutions across managed IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software and mobile application development, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent business automation, DevOps, enterprise networking, telecommunications, digital transformation, infrastructure management, ERP and CRM solutions, and managed technology support. Our experienced team works closely with organisations across diverse industries to design, implement, integrate, and support secure, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions that drive business innovation and operational excellence.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ICT Project Manager to lead the successful planning, execution and delivery of complex ICT projects across software development, AI solutions, business automation, cloud services, cybersecurity and digital transformation initiatives.

Working closely with clients, business stakeholders and multidisciplinary technical teams, you will manage the complete project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the complete lifecycle of ICT projects from initiation through planning, execution, implementation and closure.

•	Lead software development, cloud migration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent automation and digital transformation projects.

•	Collaborate with clients to gather business requirements and translate them into successful project outcomes.

•	Develop project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones and resource allocation plans.

•	Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, AI engineers, cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, business analysts and cybersecurity specialists.

•	Manage Agile, Scrum and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

•	Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, issues and quality standards while ensuring successful project delivery.

•	Facilitate project workshops, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, stakeholder meetings and executive reporting.

•	Manage project governance, change requests, risk mitigation and quality assurance activities.

•	Coordinate with third-party vendors and technology partners to support successful project implementation.

•	Ensure successful deployment, client acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover following project completion.

•	Continuously improve project management processes and delivery frameworks across the organisation.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

•	Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a closely related ICT discipline.

•	Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects.

•	Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure or digital transformation projects.

•	Experience managing Agile and Scrum software development projects.

•	Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

•	Excellent leadership, communication and organisational abilities.

•	Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks and multidisciplinary project teams.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills

•	Experience delivering AI, Generative AI or intelligent automation projects.

•	Experience with workflow automation platforms including n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make.com or similar technologies.

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise networking and managed IT services.

•	Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Trello, Monday.com or similar project management platforms.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

Why Join Loginet Technologies?

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.

We offer:

•	Competitive remuneration package

•	Ongoing professional development and certification support

•	Flexible working arrangements

•	Exposure to enterprise cloud, AI and digital transformation projects

•	Career progression opportunities

•	Supportive and collaborative team culture

Interested applicant may submit their application to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.
